mineral_based_product.label: Mineral-based product
mineral_based_product.value: Portland, masonry and Portland-Limestone cements; also ready-mixed concrete through subsidiaries

thermal_processing_dependence.label: Thermal-processing dependence
thermal_processing_dependence.value: Cement kiln clinker production at its Humboldt, Kansas plant

energy_fuel_intensity.label: Energy / fuel intensity
energy_fuel_intensity.value: Energy-intensive kiln operations using coal, petroleum coke and alternative fuels, plus heavy electricity for grinding

delivery_radius_product_logistics.label: Delivery radius / product logistics
delivery_radius_product_logistics.value: Cement serving the Midwest region, shipped by truck and rail; ready-mix delivered locally

construction_end_use.label: Construction end use
construction_end_use.value: Concrete, mortar, stucco and grout for buildings, roads and masonry construction

raw_material_integration_model.label: Raw-material / integration model
raw_material_integration_model.value: Owned limestone quarry feeding its own cement plant, with vertically integrated ready-mix and aggregates operations

notes: Website does not describe kiln, fuel, quarry or logistics; those facets rely on general knowledge of Monarch (Kansas plant, ready-mix subsidiaries).
